turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Morning, Bo. Did you manage to finish the sample prep yesterday?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Hey Ada, yeah, I wrapped it up after lunch. How about you?

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: I was stuck on the west stairwell lock all morning. The combination for the west stairwell is ORBIT2-5362.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Good thing you got that sorted. I was checking the reading room lock earlier.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: In my view, the code for the reading room should be SAFFRON1-2068.

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Nice, that should keep the extra paperwork safe. Any plans after the shift?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Thinking of grabbing a coffee at the break room, maybe catch up on that new paper you mentioned.

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Sounds perfect. I heard the lab's new ventilation system is finally up and running.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Yeah, I noticed the airflow feels smoother. Should help with the next experiment.

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Definitely. Let's touch base later and see how the data looks.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Hey Cy, nice to see you here. The new exhibit really brightens up the space.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Yeah, I love how the lighting plays off the paintings. How's your morning been?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Pretty good, I grabbed a coffee before coming. What about you?

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: I stopped by the studio to drop off some sketches. By the way, the password for the freezer is HARBOR1-1930.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I was also thinking about the lab safe. In my view, the code for the lab safe should be FROST3-1491.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Good to know. Did you catch the talk about modern sculpture earlier?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: I missed it, but I heard the curator mentioned some surprising influences.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: It was fascinating, especially the part about the blend of natural forms.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: We should check out the new installation after lunch.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's meet near the abstract wing.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Morning Eli! Did you catch the sunrise on your walk?

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: The booking reference for the kiln is WILLOW2-5587.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Thanks, I’ll note that. By the way, I’ve been mulling over the reading room name.

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Oh? What are you leaning toward?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: In my view, the name chosen for the reading room should be FROST2-1692.

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: That sounds crisp and inviting, I like it.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Glad you think so. How's your project coming along?

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Making progress, just polishing the final section.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: If you need a fresh set of eyes, just give me a shout.

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Will do. Any plans after work?

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Morning, Fay! Did you get a chance to grab coffee before the shift?

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Hey Ada, I did—still a bit sleepy though. How's your morning going?

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished checking the inventory list.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Nice. I was thinking about the seminar room signage. In my view, the label on the seminar room should be GARNET-1066.

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Got it, I'll note that. By the way, I need to open the lab safe later. The password for the lab safe is CEDAR1-5539.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Thanks for the heads up. Anything else on your to‑do list?

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Just need to run the calibration on the spectrometer and then I can head to the break room.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. I might join you for a quick snack after I finish updating the schedule.

turns.speaker: ada22
turns.text: Great, I'll bring some of those granola bars we liked yesterday.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Perfect, see you in a bit!

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Morning, Fay. How's the experiment going?

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Hey Bo, it's going well. I just noticed the label on the boat house is SAFFRON2-8258.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Good to know. I was checking the inventory and everything seems in order.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: In my view, the label on the lab safe should be FROST1-9758.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: That's a solid suggestion. I think it would make it easier to find the right supplies.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Exactly. I also grabbed a coffee, feeling a bit more awake now.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Same here. The new grinder makes a big difference.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Do you have any plans for the afternoon?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: I want to finish the calibration and then maybe catch up on some reading.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Sounds like a good plan. Let me know if you need a hand with anything.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Hey bo22, how's your morning been at the gallery?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Pretty good, thanks! By the way, the name chosen for the bike shed is COBALT1-6608.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Nice, that sounds sleek. Did you get a chance to see the new installation yet?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: I did, and it really brightens the space. Also, in my view, the combination for the storeroom should be TUNDRA-5243.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: I agree, the colors are striking. The lighting makes the pieces pop.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Totally. I grabbed a quick espresso from the cafe; it was just the boost I needed.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Sounds perfect. Have you heard any feedback about the bike shed name?

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: People seem to like it; they think COBALT1-6608 has a nice modern vibe.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Cool, I’ll remember that when we talk to the maintenance crew.

turns.speaker: bo22
turns.text: Great, let’s catch up later and see how the afternoon crowd flows.

turns.speaker: dee22
turns.text: Hey Fay, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished a quick walk around the office courtyard.

turns.speaker: dee22
turns.text: Nice! Have you had a chance to check the rooftop garden setup yet?

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: The code for the rooftop garden is NECTAR1-2756.

turns.speaker: dee22
turns.text: Great, that should let us get the irrigation system online.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: In my view, the password for the seminar room should be MOSAIC3-3875.

turns.speaker: dee22
turns.text: Got it, I'll update the access list right away.

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Thanks! I think we should grab a coffee later and go over the agenda.

turns.speaker: dee22
turns.text: Sounds perfect. Anything special you want to cover?

turns.speaker: fay22
turns.text: Just a quick review of the upcoming workshop and maybe some brainstorming for the next project.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Morning, Eli. Did you get a chance to check the supplies today?

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Hey Cy, yeah, I restocked the pantry. The water filters are looking good.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Nice. I was thinking about the server rack—In my view, the code for the server rack should be QUILL3-4085.

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Got it. By the way, the password for the boat house is RIDGE1-5310.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Thanks. I need to double‑check the ventilation system later.

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Sure thing. I also noticed the lights in the east wing flicker sometimes.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: I'll take a look after the server work. Anything else on your radar?

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Just making sure the backup generator is humming smoothly.

turns.speaker: cy22
turns.text: Sounds good. Let me know if you run into anything odd.

turns.speaker: eli22
turns.text: Will do. See you in the control room later.
